image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of several hockey pucks resting on an ice surface marked with red and blue lines. The central focus is a stack of two pucks: the top one is white/cream with visible text/logos, and the bottom one is standard black. To the left is a single black puck, and to the right are blurred shapes suggesting another black puck and a green marker or object. The background shows the characteristic markings of an ice hockey rink.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The primary subjects (the stacked pucks and the single puck to the left) clearly exhibit the correct aspect ratio of a hockey puck (diameter > thickness).
The objects appear as solid, opaque disks consistent with the physical form of a puck.

While the bottom puck in the stack and the left puck are black, the focal point (top of the stack) is a white/cream colored puck. Therefore, the image does not exclusively feature 'matte black' pucks, deviating from the strict description of a standard puck, though it contains them.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The top white puck in the stack has clear, legible circular text/logos printed on its face.
